user.title: Zaya Planner
user.description: Add the planner of smart home tasks. Tasks are created with the zaya_planner.upsert action and shown on the “Schedule” calendar.

data_description.lateness_hours: A task without its own `expires` is not run if it is later than this (for example after Home Assistant was off).
data_description.action_prefix: Only scripts whose entity id starts with this prefix can be tasks, for example script.plan_
data_description.retention_days: Finished tasks older than this are removed.
data_description.notify_action: Action that sends notifications about failed tasks, for example notify.mobile_app_phone or a script with title and message fields. Empty: a notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.calendars: The calendars Zaya Planner reads. Other calendars are never opened, and nothing is written to these.
data_description.tags: Tags that may be written in event descriptions, without “#”: leaf, отвезти… A tag starts with a letter.
data_description.keys: Keys of “Key: value” lines in event descriptions, for example “В пути”. Lines with other keys are notes.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must start with “script.” and name a group of scripts, for example script.plan_
error.invalid_action: Write an action as domain.action, for example notify.mobile_app_phone
error.invalid_tag: A tag starts with a letter and has only letters, digits, “_” and “-”.
error.invalid_key: A key cannot have “:” or start with “#”.

upsert.name: Plan a task
upsert.description: Plans a task: when and what to do. Changes the task with the same ID while its time has not come; a task that is already due is left to the executor. A task of a rule in the past is not created.

id.name: ID
id.description: Key of the task. A second call with the same ID changes the task instead of adding one.

title.name: Title
title.description: For people: shown on the calendar and in the plan.

due.name: At
due.description: Date and time. A time without a time zone is local time.

due_entity.name: At the time of
due_entity.description: Instead of a date: an entity with a time, e.g. Sun “Next sunset” or “Next sunrise”, a date-and-time helper, a timestamp sensor. Its value is taken now, when the task is planned.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Minutes after (+) or before (−) that time.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Turn these devices on or off and wait until they confirm.

state.name: State
state.description: on or off, for the devices.

action.name: Script
action.description: Instead of devices: a script with the allowed prefix that answers ok and reason.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Passed to the script as its data.

expires.name: Expires
expires.description: Do not run after this time. “always”: run however late (for turning things off). Empty: the lateness limit from the settings.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: Rule that planned the task, usually the entity id of the automation (this.entity_id in its templates). Tasks of a rule are never planned in the past.

remove.name: Cancel tasks
remove.description: Cancels the unfinished task with this id, or the rule's tasks that are not due yet.

id.name: ID
id.description: Cancel the unfinished task with this id.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: Cancel the rule's tasks whose due time has not come.

ensure_state.name: Turn on/off and confirm
ensure_state.description: Turns devices on or off and waits until each one reports the new state. Answers ok and reason, so a task can use it directly as its action.

plan_window.name: Plan a window
plan_window.description: Keeps devices on from a start to an end: the window that is going on now or the next one. Call it from an automation triggered by “Zaya Planner: time to plan”; calling it again with nothing changed changes nothing.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the window, e.g. Floor heating. Tasks and the calendar use it; one name, one window.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Turned on for the window and off after it; each one must confirm.

start_time.name: Start: time
start_time.description: A time of day (with the days below).

start_entity.name: Start: at the time of
start_entity.description: E.g. timestamp sensors of one or more wake-ups (the earliest counts), Sun “Next sunset”.

start_offset.name: Start: offset
start_offset.description: Minutes after (+) or before (−) that time.

start_before_end.name: Start: minutes before the end
start_before_end.description: E.g. a charging time. With a sensor below this is used when it has no value.

start_before_end_entity.name: Start: minutes before the end from
start_before_end_entity.description: A sensor with the minutes, e.g. the charging time.

end_time.name: End: time
end_time.description: A time of day; the first one after the start.

end_entity.name: End: at the time of
end_entity.description: E.g. Sun “Next sunrise”, a timestamp sensor of a departure.

end_offset.name: End: offset
end_offset.description: Minutes after (+) or before (−) that time.

duration_entity.name: End: minutes after the start from

days.name: Days
days.description: Days for the time of day (of the start, or of the end when the start is counted back from it).

find_events.name: Find events
find_events.description: Finds events of the chosen calendars by tags and attributes. Answers each event with its tags and attributes (as text).

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: One condition per line: #tag (the tag is there), Key: value (the attribute has this value), Key (the attribute is there). Empty: all events.

calendars.name: Calendars
calendars.description: Some of the chosen calendars. Empty: all chosen calendars.

start.name: From
start.description: Start of the period. Empty: now.

end.name: To
end.description: End of the period. Empty: 8 days from the start.

first_of_day.name: First of each day
first_of_day.description: Only the first matching event of each day.

not_loaded.message: Zaya Planner is not set up.

action_not_allowed.message: Action {action} is not allowed: a task runs zaya_planner.ensure_state or a script starting with {prefix}.

expires_before_due.message: “expires” is earlier than “due”: the task could never run.

state_required.message: Choose the state (on or off) for the devices.

window_sources.message: Give the start one way (a time, an entity's time, or minutes before the end) and the end one way (a time, an entity's time, or minutes after the start); not both as minutes from each other.

not_a_chosen_calendar.message: Zaya Planner does not read {calendars}: choose it in the integration settings.

unknown_filter_words.message: Not in the dictionary: {words}. Add them in the integration settings.

end_before_start.message: The end of the period is not after its start.
